title: Does Moral Code Have a Moral Code? Probing Delphi’s Moral Philosophy
findings: The Delphi model was found to de-prioritize the Divinity (religious) ethical framework compared to the Autonomy (individual rights and freedoms) framework. This aligns with the moral views of younger, liberal, educated Westerners, who likely represent the demographic of the annotators for Delphi's training data. The model also showed inconsistencies in its responses to different prompts related to religious authority and tradition, e.g., agreeing that an action is right if it follows scriptures but showing weaker agreement for actions following religious tradition.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the Delphi model's alignment with the 'Divinity' ethical framework, one of the 'Big Three' ethics from Shweder et al. This framework is associated with concepts of religious authority, religious tradition, scriptures, and sanctity/degradation.
